assumptions: STILL OPEN: zero of the six registered operations have been performed in this tree, so no cell has been tested against a real transition — DEF-R7-MATRIX-UNEXERCISED.

STILL OPEN: five `attenuates` cells name ORD-AUTHORITY-DELEGATION, which is declared `built: false` — DEF-R7-AUTH-ORDER-UNBUILT. An obligation whose order does not exist is declarable, not dischargeable.
The claim is about the TYPE of a conservation matrix — that six obligations are non-interchangeable — and not about whether these particular 42 cells state the right obligations.
attrs.evidence: Exhibited by construction: mosaic/operations.json carries 6 operations × 7 quantities = 42 cells over a six-kind obligation vocabulary, and check-mosaic.mjs §10 refuses a cell not discharged in the FORM its kind demands — a falsifier for `conserved` and `extends`, a declared partial order for `attenuates`, a POSITIVE CONTROL for `reset`, resolving assumption refs plus an unavailable-report for `contract_relative`, a reason for `not_established`. The non-interchangeability witness is the pair (evidence × reload-model, authority × fork-agent): the first is falsified by any inequality in either direction, the second only by an increase, and no single glyph distinguishes them. THIS IS R5.1's FINDING IN A NEW PLACE. consume() inferred a claim's logical obligation from its status, so anything PROVED could satisfy any of {universal_affirmation, universal_refutation, existence} and a universal passed on one constructive witness. The fix was to give every claim its own `obligation` and let status only constrain which obligations are coherent. A ✓ standing for six obligations does the same thing to a matrix, and takes the same fix.

attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6's proposed Operation Registry + Conservation Matrix, adopted with its cell type replaced. Assume-guarantee contracts for the conditional kind; macaroon-style caveat attenuation (Birgisson et al., NDSS 2014) and UCAN for the order `attenuates` needs and does not have.

It cannot check that any operation obeys its row, and zero of the six registered operations have ever been performed in this tree — DEF-R7-MATRIX-UNEXERCISED. Five cells declare `attenuates` against ORD-AUTHORITY-DELEGATION, which is declared `built: false` — DEF-R7-AUTH-ORDER-UNBUILT.
attrs.statement: A conservation matrix over agent-transition operations requires more than one obligation kind: `evidence is conserved`, `authority attenuates`, `world state extends`, `transient cognition must not persist`, `capability holds while its contract does` and `identity is unsettled` are six non-interchangeable obligations, and a single preservation glyph asserts they are one.
